lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\GroupDefaultQuota\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
3 uses of the private API of the server in 3 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

places: lib/QuotaManager.php:53 OCP\IAppConfig::deleteKey(): deprecated since Nextcloud 13; use method deleteAppValue of \OCP\IConfig

lib/QuotaManager.php:82 OCP\IAppConfig::getKeys(): deprecated since Nextcloud 13; use method getAppKeys of \OCP\IConfig  This function gets all keys of an app. Please note that the values are not returned.
lines: 2 uses in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 33 to 35. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/QuotaManager.php:53 OCP\IAppConfig::deleteKey(): deprecated since Nextcloud 13; use method deleteAppValue of \OCP\IConfig

lib/QuotaManager.php:82 OCP\IAppConfig::getKeys(): deprecated since Nextcloud 13; use method getAppKeys of \OCP\IConfig  This function gets all keys of an app. Please note that the values are not returned.

The app reads and writes its app config in 3 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
